name: Crafter
description:
**Tool Proficiency**: You gain proficiency with three different Ar tisan's Tools of your choice from the Fast Crafting table.
**Discount**: Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you r eceive a 20 percent discount on it.
**Fast Crafting**: When you finish a Long Rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table, provided you have the Artisan's Tools associated with that item and h ave proficiency w ith those tools. The item lasts until you finish another Long Rest, at which point the item fa lls apart.
